front.title: The 2.06 (No Content) Response Code for the Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP)

abstract.t: This document defines the 2.06 (No Content) response code for the Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP). The code indicates that the target resource exists but has no current representation to transfer. It allows a client to retrieve or observe a resource before that resource has any content, without the server signaling an error. This document updates RFC 7641 to allow 2.06 (No Content) notifications, and specifies how cross-proxies map the code to and from the HTTP 204 (No Content) status code.
